decision.reason: [ev-f66e20a1873d] is a single changelog line saying that "a check for user defined role referential integrity" was added (#21065). It does not say which roles or config this covers (for example, project roles or RBAC policy), where the check runs, or what triggers it. It also does not say what happens when the check fails, such as a rejection, a warning or a startup error. To fill in subject, applicability and consequence we need the PR #21065 description or the matching upgrade-guide or docs text.
